evidence.title: Deep Learning-Based Multi-User Communication Design for Dense IoT Networks: Interference-Aware Finite-Blocklength Communication and Preliminary MIMO Extensions

summary: Researchers propose a deep learning-based approach to optimize interference-aware communication for dense IoT networks, including preliminary MIMO extensions. The method improves efficiency in finite-blocklength scenarios for multi-user setups.
title: AI Advances Multi-User Communication in Dense IoT Networks with Deep Learning
